#Region "Main"
    COMMENT  Edge case: empty subflows, special chars, unicode
    SET EmptyVar TO $''''''
    SET UnicodeVar TO $'''日本語テスト ñ é ü © ® ™'''
    SET SpecialChars TO $'''Line1\nLine2\tTabbed "quoted" 'single' '''
    COMMENT  Empty loop
    LOOP FOREACH Item IN %EmptyList%
    END
    COMMENT  Nested ifs without else
    IF %x% > 0
        IF %x% > 10
            Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Large'''
        END
    END
    COMMENT  Multiple consecutive comments
    COMMENT  These test comment handling
    COMMENT  And parser resilience
    COMMENT  The end
#EndRegion
